description: Delete a wiki page and its whole history. This cannot be undone, and restore_wiki_page cannot bring it back: read it first with read_wiki_page if it may be wanted. A category's hub article is its category's path.

path.description: "" for the home page, a category's path for its hub, else <category path>/<slug>

token.description: The site token from create_site or the site's settings. Omit if your Authorization header carries it.

name: delete_wiki_page
title: Delete a wiki page
